Name: BunnyPetSkin
Author: jiafeidemao
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

Love and Deepspace fan‑art skin, replaces the vanilla cat with a fluffy round bunny.
Pure texture replacer by Content Patcher. Works for both new and old saves, no need to remove your pet.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install prerequisites: SMAPI and Content Patcher
2. Unzip the file into your Stardew Valley Mods folder
3. Launch the game, the cat will turn into bunny automatically.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

- Replace original cat sprite with bunny (Shen Xinghui bunny‑themed fan content)
- No new objects added, only visual texture change
- Compatible with new & existing save files

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI & Content Patcher

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fan‑made mod for Shen Xinghui from Love and Deepspace.[/color]
